description: Verify a bound org (org; the default org when omitted) by querying its org record through the sf CLI. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; ok, org_id, the verified username, the pinned api_version and the org's alias (org) are delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Verify the Salesforce connector is configured and reachable, surfacing the resolved org id, the authenticated username, and the API version in use. A health check for diagnosing a credential or connection problem before relying on the query and record verbs. Dispatches asynchronously -- job_id first, the health-check outcome moments later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the health-check outcome -- ok/org_id/username/api_version arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the check was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the connection result. Acknowledge the check is in flight; ok plus org_id/username land in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, report them for the operator's confirmation; low sensitivity (connection metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.not_configured: no Salesforce org is bound, or the CLI's target for the org resolves to a different instance host than the binding's pin, or sf_cli_path does not name the CLI. sf.unknown_org: org names no bound org, or several are bound and none is the default (the message lists them). sf.auth_failed: the sf CLI has no live session for the bound org. sf.api_error: an unexpected org error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_configured: bind an org with bind_org or login (list_orgs shows what is bound). sf.unknown_org: pass org as one of the listed aliases, or run set_default_org. sf.auth_failed: log the org in again with login, or ask the operator to run: sf org login web.
